title: Clinical Validation of Aptitude Project 8 - Metrix G3 Strep A Test
official: Clinical Validation of Aptitude Project 8 - Metrix G3 Strep A Test
summary: The Metrix G3 Strep A Test will be evaluated for use in Point-of-Care (POC) CLIA-waived settings utilizing the clinical study design described herein. The study will take place in intended-use POC clinical environments (e.g., urgent care clinics, retail health clinics, and outpatient physician offices) and will be performed by untrained operators representative of CLIA-waived end users. This will be a prospective study conducted at three or more investigational sites located within the United States for the clinical validation of the Metrix Strep A Test for the qualitative detection of Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A β-hemolytic Streptococcus) from throat swab samples. Additional sites may be added to the study in order to meet minimum subject/sample enrollment requirements and target disease prevalence. Comparator testing will be performed to determine the infection status of each sample for comparison to results generated by the candidate test. The patient infectious status will be determined using a standard reference method for the detection of Group A Streptococcus.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Subject is ≥3 years of age.
* 2\. Subject or guardian understands and is able and willing to provide written informed consent, and assent where applicable, prior to study enrollment.
* 3\. Subject is currently exhibiting signs/symptoms characteristic of acute pharyngitis, including presence of sore throat, and at least one other symptom from the following: Redness of the posterior pharyngeal wall; Pharyngeal or tonsillar exudate (white/yellow spots at back of throat); Tonsillar swelling; Tender cervical lymphadenopathy (swollen lymph nodes); Fever
* 4\. Subject or guardian is willing and able to contribute the required swab specimens for testing.

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Subject does not understand and/or is not able and willing to sign the study informed consent and/or assent.
* 2\. Subject has previously participated in the study.
* 3\. Subject is currently undergoing treatment with antibiotics, or has undergone treatment with antibiotics, for their current episode of pharyngitis.
* 4\. Subject has undergone antibiotic treatment for pharyngitis within the last 30 days.
* 5\. Subject has used throat lozenges, anesthetic throat drops/sprays, or medicated gargles within an hour prior to sample collection.
* 6\. Subject's symptom onset was ≥14 days prior to study participation.
